requirement.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: sewage-treatment approval/compliance and distance properties
requirement.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF sewage_discharge_uses_treatment_plant = true, THEN sewage_treatment_plant_approval_status = approved, MARPOL_IV_9_1_1_or_9_2_1_certification_status = compliant, MARPOL_IV_11_1_2_discharge_status = compliant, and distances to land, ice shelf, fast ice, and ice concentration greater than 1/10 shall be recorded.
requirement.requiredInputs: Treatment-plant certificate, MARPOL compliance evidence, and discharge position/ice data
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: The ship has in operation an approved sewage treatment plant certified by the Administration to meet the operational requirements in either regulation 9.1.1 or 9.2.1 of MARPOL Annex IV, and discharges sewage in accordance with regulation 11.1.2 of Annex IV and shall be as far as practicable from the nearest land, any ice-shelf, fast ice or areas of ice concentration exceeding 1/10.
